For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, signNow, or DocuSign**\. The best one depends on whether you prioritize affordability, simplicity, or advanced features.

Here are my top picks for 2026, including options worth considering for a Canadian business.

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use and set up
- Reusable templates and reminders
- Good document tracking and audit trails
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans

Published starting price: approximately US\$15/month, annual billing.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

- Affordable subscription options
- Templates and automated workflows
- Multiple signers
- Good for contracts, forms and approvals

Published starting price: approximately US\$8/user/month, annual billing.

[Visit signNow](https://www.signnow.com/)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small business\:

| Priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Easiest to use | Dropbox Sign |
| Best value | signNow |
| Most established | DocuSign |
| Proposals and sales | PandaDoc |
| PDF-heavy business | Adobe Sign |
| Low-cost Zoho integration | Zoho Sign |


One important consideration in Canada: check the provider's data residency, privacy protections, audit trails and suitability for your particular contracts. Electronic signature validity depends on the type of document and applicable Canadian law.
